# Game Idea: Space Debris Dodge

- **Genre:** Endless runner / dodge
- **Controls:** Arrow keys (or WASD) to move a small ship on the canvas.
- **Goal:** Survive as long as possible by avoiding randomly generated debris that flies in from the edges.
- **Mechanic:** Debris spawns at random intervals and speeds; the ship can accelerate in four directions but has limited inertia.
- **Lose Condition:** The ship collides with any debris or moves outside the canvas bounds, ending the game.
- **Visuals:** Simple shapes (triangle for ship, circles for debris) drawn on an HTML `<canvas>`.
- **Scoring:** Distance survived or time elapsed, displayed on-screen.

1: // Simple endless‑runner with enhanced graphics
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
7:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
8: 
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Ship (approximated as circle for collision)
12:   const ship = {
13:     x: width / 2,
14:     y: height / 2,
15:     r: 12,
16:     speed: 2,
17:     vx: 0,
18:     vy: 0,
19:   };
20: 
21:   // Debris objects (circles)
22:   const debris = [];
23:   const stars = [];
24:   const shipTrail = [];
25:   const spawnInterval = 1000; // ms
26:   let lastSpawn = 0;
27:   let score = 0;
28:   let gameOver = false;
29: 
30:   const keys = {};
31:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
32:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
33: 
34:   function spawnDebris() {
35:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
36:     const size = 8 + Math.random() * 12;
37:     let x, y, vx, vy;
38:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
39:     switch (edge) {
40:       case 0: // top
41:         x = Math.random() * width;
42:         y = -size;
43:         vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
44:         vy = speed;
45:         break;
46:       case 1: // bottom
47:         x = Math.random() * width;
48:         y = height + size;
49:         vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
50:         vy = -speed;
51:         break;
52:       case 2: // left
53:         x = -size;
54:         y = Math.random() * height;
55:         vx = speed;
56:         vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
57:         break;
58:       case 3: // right
59:         x = width + size;
60:         y = Math.random() * height;
61:         vx = -speed;
62:         vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
63:         break;
64:     }
65:     debris.push({ x, y, r: size, vx, vy });
66:   }
67: 
68:   function update(dt) {
69:     // add current position to ship trail
70:     shipTrail.push({ x: ship.x, y: ship.y, alpha: 1 });
71:     if (shipTrail.length > 20) shipTrail.shift();
72:     // fade trail particles
73:     for (let i = 0; i < shipTrail.length; i++) {
74:       shipTrail[i].alpha *= 0.96;
75:     }
76:     // ship control – simple acceleration
77:     if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) ship.vy -= ship.speed * 0.02;
78:     if (keys.ArrowDown || keys.s) ship.vy += ship.speed * 0.02;
79:     if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) ship.vx -= ship.speed * 0.02;
80:     if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) ship.vx += ship.speed * 0.02;
81: 
82:     // apply inertia & clamp speed
83:     ship.vx *= 0.98;
84:     ship.vy *= 0.98;
85:     ship.x += ship.vx;
86:     ship.y += ship.vy;
87: 
88:     // boundary check (lose if outside)
89:     if (ship.x < 0 || ship.x > width || ship.y < 0 || ship.y > height) gameOver = true;
90: 
91:     // update debris
92:     for (let i = debris.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
93:       const d = debris[i];
94:       d.x += d.vx;
95:       d.y += d.vy;
96:       // remove if far off screen
97:       if (d.x < -50 || d.x > width + 50 || d.y < -50 || d.y > height + 50) {
98:         debris.splice(i, 1);
99:       }
100:     }
101: 
102:     // collision detection
103:     for (const d of debris) {
104:       const dx = ship.x - d.x;
105:       const dy = ship.y - d.y;
106:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
107:       if (dist < ship.r + d.r) {
108:         gameOver = true;
109:         break;
110:       }
111:     }
112: 
113:     // spawn new debris
114:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
115:       spawnDebris();
116:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
117:     }
118: 
119:     // score as time survived (seconds)
120:     score = Math.floor(performance.now() / 1000);
121:   }
122: 
123:   function drawShip() {
124:     ctx.save();
125:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
126:     ctx.beginPath();
127:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.r);
128:     ctx.lineTo(ship.r, ship.r);
129:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, ship.r);
130:     ctx.closePath();
131:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
132:     ctx.fill();
133:     ctx.restore();
134:   }
135: 
136:   function draw() {
137:     // background gradient
138:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
139:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
140:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#004');
141:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
142:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
143:     // stars background
144:     for (const s of stars) {
145:       ctx.beginPath();
146:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
147:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${s.alpha})`;
148:       ctx.fill();
149:     }
150:     // debris
151:     // use radial gradient for each debris piece
152: 
153:     // debris with radial gradient
154:     for (const d of debris) {
155:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(d.x, d.y, 0, d.x, d.y, d.r);
156:       grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,80,80,0.9)');
157:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(150,0,0,0.3)');
158:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
159:       ctx.beginPath();
160:       ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
161:       ctx.fill();
162:     }
163:     // ship
164:     drawShip();
165:     // score
166:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
167:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
168:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
169:     if (gameOver) {
170:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
171:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
172:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
173:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
174:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
175:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
176:     }
177:   }
178: 
179:   let lastTime = 0;
180:   function loop(timestamp) {

182:     lastTime = timestamp;
183:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
184:     draw();
185:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
